 "rationale": "The gain of about 70 dB comes from two stages, which is needed because a single stage loses gain at hot corners. The PMOS CS output stage gives a rail-to-rail-ish swing of about 1.3 V even at 1.62 V. The current budget is Iref 10 uA + Itail 60 uA + I7 250 uA = 0.32 mA, about 0.63 mW at 1.98 V. Targeting GBW of about 24 MHz with Cc = 2 pF and p2 of about 110 MHz gives a PM of about 75 deg. A long-L input pair (area) controls flicker noise. M6 is matched to the mirror's Vsg."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # input pair L (area -> flicker noise)
    "Itail": (60e-6, 30e-6, 150e-6), # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror / 2nd-stage gm/Id (matched)
    "Lp":    (0.7, 0.4, 1.5),        # PMOS mirror / 2nd-stage L (matched)
    "gmidn": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # NMOS bias mirrors gm/Id
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias mirrors L
    "I7":    (250e-6, 120e-6, 450e-6),# 2nd-stage current
    "Cc":    (2.0e-12, 1.0e-12, 3.5e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.5, 1.0, 3.0),        # Rz = rzk/gm6 (LHP zero)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]

    # devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5)               # input pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.8)               # mirror load
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.8)                   # 2nd stage CS (matched Vsg)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)                # ibias diode
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)                  # tail
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)                   # output sink
    Rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # first stage: vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # compensation
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1, gm6 = m1.gm, m6.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    wu = gm1 / Cc
    ugbw = wu / (2 * PI)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * Cc + cl * Cc + C1 * cl)
    rz_eff = Rz - 1.0 / gm6
    z = 1.0 / (Cc * rz_eff) if rz_eff > 0 else 1e15
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / z)) \
            - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / pmir))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    tau = 1.0 / wu
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    nth = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = nth * 3.0  # rough flicker allowance
    cmrr_db = db(2 * gm1 / m5.gds * 0.5 * A1 / A1) + 20
    psrr_db = gain_db - 25
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db}
